Decision: Open: rule for reduced genomes; annotation of 23 genomes without NCBI proteins; haplotype check for Dermanyssus gallinae, Amphitetranychus viennensis, Panonychus citri

Question tested: Which lifestyle type does each Phytoseiidae species in batch 1 have?
Tool and version: McMurtry, De Moraes and Sourassou (2013), Systematic and Applied Acarology 18(4): 297-320
Parameters / model: Read from the text of the Type I, II and III sections
